m0-context.title: Load baseline context
m0-context.imperative: Read inherited global doctrine (global-crew.md, global-everyone.md), the g4 handoff, and the composed g1/g2/g3 files + pooling.py. Verify the handoff is complete. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: crew+everyone doctrine + handoff + g1/g2/g3 + pooling.py read; handoff complete

m1-layer3.title: layer3_fieldcar.py — two-stage field-car decomposition
m1-layer3.imperative: Build src/physics/weekend_state/layer3_fieldcar.py: (a) RELATIVE = car residual - weekend field median (reuse floor.weekend_relative) with sigma from car _sigma + field-median SE; (b) RE-ANCHOR = smooth field-car absolute trajectory per (year) over round_idx via fit_drift/DriftFit.predict on per-weekend field medians; absolute = fieldcar_traj + relative. Each stage carries sigma. Write tests/unit/physics/weekend_state/test_layer3_fieldcar.py: reconstruction identity (fieldcar+relative==absolute), sigma present, fit_drift IMPORTED from pooling.py (assert import). Test-after.
constraints: reuse floor.weekend_relative + pooling.fit_drift; no evo import; each stage carries sigma

m2-layer4.title: layer4_car.py — shrunk car signal (pool_random_effects)
m2-layer4.imperative: Build src/physics/weekend_state/layer4_car.py: car signal = pool_random_effects shrunk per-weekend relative deltas off the field car. fit_car_pools(train) -> per car-season (mu,tau,sigma_mu) via pool_random_effects; car_signal_for_row applies the SAME EB shrink formula row-wise using TRAIN mu/tau (no re-pooling of predict df). Carry sigma. Add layer4 tests to test_model.py (pool_random_effects IMPORTED + asserted; train-point shrink reproduces pool.shrunk faithfully). Test-after.
constraints: reuse pooling.pool_random_effects; row-wise apply with train hyperparameters (no re-pool); no evo import; carry sigma

m3-model.title: model.py — L1->L2->L3->L4 assembler, leak-free held-out
m3-model.imperative: Build src/physics/weekend_state/model.py: WeekendStateModel.fit(train) fits L1 density betas, L3 field-car DriftFit (train-only), L4 pools (train-only); transform/car_signal applies stored TRAIN hyperparameters row-wise (per-year L1 so mass is inert), producing per axis a decomposed state + {axis}_car_signal, each layer carrying its own sigma. Finish test_model.py: assembly, per-layer sigma present, NO-LEAKAGE (held-out car-signal identical with/without other held-out weekends in the predict population), model output feeds gate_spec.signal_preservation_guard/evaluate_axis directly, no evo import. Test-after.
constraints: train-only hyperparameters for held-out; no-leakage proven by test; feeds gate_spec; no evo import; no data/*.db staged
